verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yo evaṁ saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, appamādo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that leads to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching like diligence.

verses.pali: Appamādo, bhikkhave, saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattatī”ti.
verses.english: Diligence leads to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.”
